Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowships 2027-28 is an opportunity offered by the United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF) to outstanding Indian students. Under this fellowship, the selected candidates can pursue a master's degree program at selected U.S. colleges and universities in the specified areas of study. The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend along with other benefits.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
have completed an equivalent of a U.S. bachelor's degree from a recognized Indian university with at least 55% marks
possess a four-year bachelor's degree or have completed a master's degree
have a full-time postgraduate diploma from a recognized Indian institution, if the bachelor's degree is of less than four years duration
have at least three years of full-time (paid) professional work experience relevant to the proposed field of study
be experienced in leadership and community service
not have another degree from a U.S. university or be enrolled in a U.S. degree program
The selected applicants will receive the following benefits -
Round-trip economy class air travel from the fellow's home city to the host institution in the U.S
Accident and sickness coverage as per U.S. government guidelines
The Fulbright-Nehru Master's fellowships provide no financial support to dependents.
USIEF funding will not cover all costs, and the fellows will need to supplement grant benefits with other resources.
Scanned copies of your mark sheets or transcripts and diploma/degree certificates
Scanned copies of proof of work/professional experience

Question: Who is offering this opprtunity?
This fellowship is being offered by the United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF).
Question: Can I apply offline for the Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowship?
No, students can only apply online for this fellowship.
Question: Can Indian citizens apply for this fellowship?
Yes, Indian citizens are eligible to apply for this fellowship.
Question: Is there any minimum percentage requirement for this fellowship?
An applicant must have completed an equivalent of a U.S. bachelor's degree from a recognized Indian university with at least 55% marks.
